name: KI-Status
author: gradiscp
description: Whether Claude Code or Codex sessions are waiting for a permission; a click opens a panel with every session, what the waiting ones ask for, the last toasts and the toast switch; a right-click mutes the toasts.

barWidget.description: Terminal glyph that lights up in the bar's urgent colour while Claude Code or Codex sessions wait for a permission; a click opens the session panel.
